title: Why Ground Beef Prices Are Sky-High

scenes.narration: Have you noticed your grocery bill hitting record levels lately?

visual.text: Why Ground Beef Prices Are Sky-High

scenes.narration: Between early 2020 and October 2026, ground beef prices jumped by an eye-watering 74%.
While other meats faced inflation, beef completely decoupled from the rest of the aisle.
The full story is on the channel.

visual.text: Beef is in a league of its own

scenes.narration: Why has the price of your weekly burger changed so much in a decade?
Since January 2015, the price of ground beef has climbed a staggering 60%.
In that same time, chicken breast rose only 19% and bacon gained 20%.
The full story is on the channel.

title: Why Beef Prices Refuse to Drop

scenes.narration: Did you know that beef prices spiked 22% in just the last 21 months?

visual.text: Why Beef Prices Refuse to Drop

scenes.narration: Between January 2025 and October 2026, ground beef surged 22% while other meats cooled off.
Biology is the key: cattle reproduce slowly, making herd recovery a years-long process.
The full story is on the channel.
